notes_for_editor: Build year, height, cab and destruction date come from firelookout.com alone. The 1963 USGS map (Pastmaps page) confirms a tower on the summit that year. Its description text reads like generated copy, so check the map image before publishing; the on-summit wording comes only from that text, and the story otherwise leans on the map date. The phrase Patrol 3 miles northwest atop Gold Hill is ambiguous (it may describe the tower's patrol point or its location); the story words it as a listed patrol point. The firelookout page credits photos to the Western News (Libby), which suggests newspaper coverage that was not searched. Height 48 feet converted to 14.6 m. Fact-check 2026-10-10: Lincoln County, the USGS label and the summit wording were checked on the cited pages and added to evidence. Searches run: 2.
